benefits.name: Anniversary OneKeyCash Bonus
benefits.description: $100 in OneKeyCash deposited into the linked One Key account each cardholder anniversary.
benefits.terms: OneKeyCash is not redeemable for cash and can only be used on Expedia, Hotels.com and Vrbo.

benefits.name: One Key Gold Tier Status
benefits.description: Automatic Gold tier status in the One Key loyalty program (Expedia, Hotels.com, Vrbo).

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: One statement credit of up to $120 every four years as reimbursement for a Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee.

benefits.name: Cellular Telephone Protection
benefits.description: Up to $1,000 per claim against damage or theft when the monthly cell phone bill is paid with the card.
benefits.terms: $25 deductible per claim; maximum of 2 paid claims and $2,000 per 12-month period.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Coverage up to $50,000 for damage/theft of a rental vehicle paid with the card; primary within the United States (except New York).
benefits.terms: Rental periods up to 31 consecutive days. Decline the rental company's collision damage waiver.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Protection
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $5,000 per covered traveler per trip for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses, up to $20,000 per 12-month period.

benefits.name: Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $1,000,000 per account of common carrier travel accident coverage when the fare is paid with the card.

earningRates.terms: Earned as OneKeyCash, which can only be redeemed on Expedia, Hotels.com and Vrbo (not for cash).
